messages:
alex: Quick sync — release orbit checklist. Target: SDK v1.8 deploy next Tue (2026-03-24). Changelog cutoff: Fri EOD (2026-03-20). We need owners + status for: docs, quickstarts, sample apps, changelog, and go/no-go signoff. Posting current items below, pls react or reply with ✅/❌ and ETA.
maria: I can own docs. Main tasks: update API reference for new `batching` param, add migration note for `ClientConfig`, and publish quickstart with new auth flow. ETA: Mon noon. Will ping when previews up.
sam: Sample apps: 3 apps with PRs open — web-chat (#432), embeddings-demo (#441), batching-bench (#447). Web-chat has a failing test (CORS) I'm debugging. ETA: web-chat fix by Thu, others ready for review.
jen: QA: running smoke + e2e nightly. Found two flaky tests in embeddings-demo (race on mock server) — I'll post flaky test logs in the PR. If sam can re-run mock with timeout -> should be stable. Otherwise we delay sample app gating.
leo: Release ops notes: Canary window Tue 09:00-11:00 PST. If canary passes, full rollout Wed 02:00-06:00 PST. Need final changelog and release notes by Mon EOD for marketing packaging. Also need a named go/no-go owner for final decision at Tue 08:00 PST.
emily: Code review pings: @sam please address comments on #441 (embedding config) and @alex can you lgtm #456 (runtime batching fallback) — small change. I can help with quick reviews Fri morning.
ci-bot: CI summary: master -> 1976543205, 5 checks passing, 2 flaky failures on embeddings-demo-e2e. (add reaction :eyes:)
alex: Thanks — owners: docs=@maria, samples=@sam, qa=@jen, changelog=@alex, release-owner=@leo. Can each owner confirm? Also diff for changelog generator below — use this to compile entries:
```
./scripts/gen_changelog --since v1.7 --format markdown > changelog/v1.8.md
```
maria: Confirmed. I'll push preview link by Mon 11:30. Will also add a short migration snippet for `ClientConfig.batch_size`.
sam: Confirmed for samples. I'll push web-chat fix PR by Thu 15:00 and request reviews. If QA still flaky, I'll add a retry in mock server as temporary hack.
jen: Confirmed. I'll re-run nightly smoke after sam's PR and report pass/fail. If still failing, propose short rollback plan for sample registry.
leo: Confirmed as release-owner. I'll chair Tue 08:00 go/no-go. If we have outstanding blockers, call it early. Please add blockers as comments in this thread.
emily: Small ask — can docs include a short code snippet showing new batching behavior with `stream=true`? makes it easier for users. @maria
maria: Good call, will add that. Also adding a note about token accounting changes.
alex: One last: changelog PR should include referenced GH issues/PRs. I'll assemble a release notes draft Mon afternoon and send to marketing for copy. If anyone wants something highlighted, drop a short sentence here.
sam: Highlight: embedding config defaults changed to `normalize=true` — callout in release notes please.
jen: Blocker: embeddings-demo flaky test might need a small refactor; if we can't stabilize by Mon EOD, recommend we decouple that sample from initial docs release and ship it as a follow-up patch.
alex: Noted. If decoupled, update release notes with a follow-up ticket. Everyone — please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is green. I'll reconvene here Mon 16:00 for a final preflight check.
ci-bot: Reminder scheduled: @channel Preflight reminder Mon 15:55 PST.
leo: Added calendar invite for Tue 08:00 PST go/no-go (30m). Agenda: canary metrics, critical PRs, rollback plan.
